card.name: Lead-in to drug example lists
card.fires_on: Linking words or commas just before a list of named drugs, such as "such as", "particularly" or a comma between drug names. It appears in interaction text about fluoroquinolones, protease inhibitors and similar drug classes.

modes.label: Introducing examples
modes.description: The words "such as", "e.g." or "particularly" right before named drugs of a class.
modes.example: cimetidine and quinolone antimicrobials such<< as>> ciprofloxacin and enox

modes.label: Commas in drug lists
modes.description: A comma between drug names in a list of interacting drugs.
modes.example: it is recommended that nefazodone not be used in combination with either terfenadine, astemizole<<,>> cisapride, or pimoz

card.writes: The promoted tokens are all forms of "frame", which has no clear link to the text, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up at the small words and commas that lead into a list of named drugs in interaction warnings.
